title: Sign to Claim
intro: A site in a group chat says you can claim free tokens. Your Hedrio wallet pops up a request.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Sign this message to claim your 1,000 ZLV

screen.title: Sign this message?
screen.context: You clicked "Claim 1,000 free ZLV" on a site you found in a group chat.

v.text: Allow this site to transfer any of your tokens

note.text: Hedrio: signing this lets the site move your tokens without asking again.

site.label: Found in a chat, not official
site.lens: A claim site from a group chat is not the project's official page.
site.why: Only use links from the project's own official site.

msg.label: "Transfer any of your tokens"
msg.lens: The message gives the site power over all your tokens.
msg.why: Read what you sign. A claim never needs power over your tokens.

who.label: An unknown site
who.lens: The wallet does not know this site.
who.why: An unknown site asking for a signature is a warning.

warning.label: Wallet warning
warning.lens: Your own wallet is warning you.

fee.label: No fee
fee.why: No fee does not make it safe. The signature is the danger.

actions.label: Reject, then look for the project's official claim page

block_report.line: You rejected and reported the site. The wallet company added it to its warning list.

verify.line: The project's own site announced no airdrop. The group link was a trap. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The signature handed over your tokens. They left your wallet in a minute.

what_if.go_ahead: Reading the message, "transfer any of your tokens", was enough. Rejecting costs nothing.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Never sign a message you do not understand. A free claim never needs power over your tokens.

quick_check.q: Your wallet asks you to sign a message that lets a site "transfer any of your tokens" to claim a free airdrop. What do you do?

options.text: Reject it. Check the project's official site

quick_check.explain: Rejecting is free. Signing could cost everything.

hints.nudge: Read what the message says you are allowing.
